history: Softening remains active during balance and excavation; all retained history is preserved.

cut.predicate: reference x >= 2.2 m, across the full occupied height
cut.removed_objects: soil particles, mass, volume and history records
cut.meaning: full-height toe removal with a new vertical face approximately 0.52 m high

scope: Exploratory localization study; no prescribed weak stripe, global strength ramp, energy certification, site calibration or mesh-objective bandwidth claim.

constitutive_variant.shear_driver: Sum of positive MC surface multipliers times sqrt(2/3) ||dev(B_MC)||; includes a new multi-face corner definition.
constitutive_variant.tensile_diagnostic: Sum of positive Rankine multipliers from total trace minus MC trace; diagnostic only, without reducing T0.
constitutive_variant.normalization: Single-face definition matches the baseline; differs from FLAC normalization.
constitutive_variant.post_saturation: Freeze the shear-driving history after strength reaches residual; mark all-zero stress partitions as ambiguous.

comparison_scope: Includes a new multi-MC-corner hardening definition; this changes more than one constitutive assumption.
